text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.
reply_text:
I found two Marrow Agrisupply sites in #central-team and a possible third. I've sent you the list in our DM.

1. Eastbank: Hollis raised it on 9 Jun 2026. Ticket PD-4821 has Eastbank's receiving-door import attached. The file labels the doors E1/E2 but their booking sheet uses 01/02, so that needs sorting out before anyone reimports, or you'll get duplicates.
2. Pine Crossing: you raised it on 9 Jun 2026. The morning receiver's appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce it.
3. Wichita (possible): on 2 Jul 2025 you mentioned an 8am check-in with "the Wichita store dispatcher." Tobias had just brought up the Marrow Agrisupply office hours link, but the message never says Wichita is a Marrow store. Please confirm before you count it.

I left out the Tulsa hub from that 2025 conversation because it belongs to Tansley Parcel, not Marrow. On 9 Jun you also said Marrow's rollout tracker had three rows marked "waiting," but the channel never names those stores. The tracker itself may have more sites that never came up in the channel.
